text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew... And here I thought it was a good 
idea~...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, morning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ahaha, it's nothing~!
choice_data_list: ……何かあった？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, I've got preparations for the 
Fan Thanksgiving Festival after this. I 
might be a little late to training, okay? 
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The paper she left behind catches my eye. 
It looks like the layout map for the Fan 
Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a proposal to rearrange the 
layout and decorate each area, but... I 
haven't heard anything about the plan 
being approved.
choice_data_list: ...Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true. Copano Rickey did mention 
something about rearranging the venue.
choice_data_list: ……これは、もしかして

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot possibly approve this. 
Rearranging the entire venue based on feng 
shui, of all things..."
choice_data_list: やっぱり……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly an outrageous scale. Still, 
she likely proposed it with the intent to 
channel good energy throughout the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She always senses others' troubles, shows 
concern, and gives her all to bring them 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She only ever wanted to make someone 
happy. If she's wearing such a sad 
expression—
choice_data_list: (I want to do something for her...!)
(I want to do something to help her...!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
How flexible are we with reassignments, 
you ask?
choice_data_list: （俺が、なんとかしてあげたい……！）
（私が、なんとかしてあげたい……！）
choice_data_list_en: (I want to do something to help her...!)
(I want to do something to help her...!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We've already submitted the instruction 
sheets to the contractor ...so 
unfortunately, I think it would be 
difficult...
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look back over the notebook where I 
wrote down all the Feng Shui tips Copano 
Rickey taught me.
choice_data_list: なるほど……

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are the lights still on in Trainer's 
room?
choice_data_list: 何か、この中にヒントは……
choice_data_list_en: Could there be some hint in here...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: They're working so hard... Oh, I know☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Pardon me!
choice_data_list: Ricky! What happened?
Ricky! What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, because Trainer's working so hard! 
I came to clean up and put out some 
houseplants!
choice_data_list: リッキー！どうしたんだ？
リッキー！どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Cleaning is the foundation of feng shui, 
but properly decorating will bring even 
more luck☆ And that'll make you happy too, 
Trainer!"
choice_data_list:
(She must be feeling down deep inside, 
though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, looking at her, inspiration 
strikes. Cleaning and decorating. If I 
base everything around these two 
fundamentals of feng shui...
choice_data_list: （本当は落ち込んでいるんだろうに……）
choice_data_list_en: (Even though she must be feeling down deep inside...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho, I see. Just 'cleaning and decorating 
the gate', is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In feng shui, the entryway holds great 
significance... In that case, if we can 
align the festival's main gate according 
to feng shui..."
choice_data_list: Her wish is sure to come true

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, I have accepted it. ...As 
long as it stays within reason, adding a 
bit of flair is more than welcome.
choice_data_list: 彼女の希望は、叶えられるはず
choice_data_list_en: Her wish will surely come true.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really, Trainer? Really-really? You 
got permission to decorate the gate?
choice_data_list:
It might not be enough for the original 
plan, though...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: 元々の計画には足りないかもしれないけど
choice_data_list_en: It might not be quite enough for the original plan, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it, um... Things like 
this don't happen often, so I was 
surprised...
choice_data_list: リッキー？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's kind of ticklish! Like you've 
seen right through me...!
choice_data_list: It's what Ricky always does!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing someone's worries and solving 
them. I think I was able to do it because 
I watched it happen right by my side.
choice_data_list: リッキーがいつもやってることだよ

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
N-No way~...! I just wanted everyone's 
worries to go away and for them to be 
happy~!
choice_data_list: Then I'll make Rickey happy myself.
Then I'll make Rickey happy myself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: じゃあ、リッキーのことは俺が幸せにするよ
じゃあ、リッキーのことは私が幸せにするよ

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Hold on a second.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...It feels nice, doesn't it? Having 
someone do things for you..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: No problem! Piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: なんの！お安い御用！
choice_data_list_en: Think nothing of it! It's a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing!
choice_data_list: ……どうしたんだ？
……どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Ummm. Well, hehe...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Aah! I'm gonna go grab some tea!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...All right! Let's do our best and 
decorate the gate!
choice_data_list: It's for the kids who come to visit, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Even more than usual, extra 
special happiness!
choice_data_list: 遊びに来る子たちのためにも！
choice_data_list_en: For the sake of the kids coming to play, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, oh, right! What were we talking 
about again?"
choice_data_list:
Are we talking about doing our best to 
decorate the gate, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh, right... ...I might not be 
feeling up to it today...
choice_data_list: 門の飾りつけを頑張ろうって話かな？
choice_data_list_en: Are we talking about putting our all into decorating the gate?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: It's no big deal!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Um, hey?
choice_data_list: どうってことないよ！

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Are you doing that unconsciously, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: It's no big deal!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer, that thing you have... 
...Never mind.
choice_data_list: どうってことないよ！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After that, she fell completely silent. 
Alongside a wordlessly following Copano 
Rickey, we focused diligently on 
decorating the gate..."
